_comment: One seeded server per addon type under admin/src/Addons/Servers, so every supported type has a row to attach media to. Servers carry no credentials: params and media stay empty and the addon's own defaults apply, so nothing here can reach an outside account. `requires` names a component the site must already have (Docman and Virtuemart are other vendors' extensions); without it the server is skipped and reported, never an error. The legacy type is deliberately absent: it is deprecated, a fresh install already seeds legacy servers, and new use is refused.
